baseline.state: First offer in freshly selected Shamshabad

input.method: Supported visible CUA button clicks, bounded native key holds, AX text, original screenshots and browser console logs. No hidden state, game-logic evaluation, teleporting, autopilot or engine stepping.
input.timingLimit: 38.70 s is the sum of explicit movement-key holds, including braking/reversing and airborne movement. It excludes taps, UI clicks, coasting, recovery animation, pauses and tool latency.

steps: Create new base-URL tab, read loaded script src, click Play, fill Search an area with Shamshabad and click Shamshabad Start here. Accept the first Airport Bawarchi offer; no Another or reroll.

Press M and inspect the pickup northwest of Shamshabad, then click actual Close. W 1.1 s/S 0.45 s and W 0.5 s/W+A 0.9 s/S 0.5 s move from 920 m to 897 m. HUD displays Road ahead blocked · check the map. The car is beside a tan facade; no hard route failure is established.

W+A 0.45 s/W 1.2 s/S 0.4 s reaches 892 m. S 1.5 s/W+A 1.6 s/S 0.35 s clears the facade but reads 894 m. W+D 0.4 s/W 2 s/S 0.5 s steers off the local road; HUD changes to approximate direct distance ~534 m. S 0.6 s, R and M recover and inspect map. Close map shows intermediate recovery/off-road guidance ~547 m; this is not counted as a settled recovery failure.

W 1.3 s/S 0.45 s returns to road-route guidance at 866 m. W+A 0.9 s/S 0.35 s begins a left turn (867 m). W+D 0.25 s/W 2.5 s/S 0.65 s oversteers into a frontage, showing ~528 m off-road. Press R a second time and P, then Resume. The recovery animation settles subsequently to a road view with 836 m route distance and 5.0 s boost.

Perform one controlled PT-013 recurrence at 0 km/h: click Minimap, click actual Close, observe focus on Minimap, tap Space and observe City map reopen. Capture original; click Close again. Boost remains 5.0 s and speed remains 0, with no flight observed.

Click visible game scene before resuming driving. W 3 s/S 0.8 s follows the narrow street to 785 m and a broad arterial T junction. W+D 0.65 s/S 0.5 s begins right turn (783 m); S 1 s/W+D 1.7 s/S 0.35 s completes most alignment (779 m). Visible autos, people, central planters and Hassan Dairy Farm sign pass through view. Toast says Arre! Watch the auto!, and boost rises to 7.5 s.

W 4.5 s/S 0.8 s moves alongside traffic and onto the sidewalk; toast says Arre! Watch the traffic!, guidance switches to ~517 m direct. Do not infer a collision fault from this uncontrolled approach. Space with scene focus, W+D 0.15 s and W 2.5 s produce actual visible Flying guidance, approximately 477 m, 4.8 s boost and 115 km/h in AX (later screenshot 473 m, 4.7 s, 114 km/h).

Tap Space again, S 1.8 s and P. Resume and S 0.55 s show flight still active at ~387 m and 0.1 s boost. S 1 s produces a later grounded/off-road HUD ~393 m near rail geometry; long S has entered reverse. W 0.55 s changes speed to 16 km/h. Capture final original at ~395 m, then P and verify Paused with Resume focused. No collection prompt or interaction result occurred.

Read captured warn/error logs (empty), mark Shamshabad as handoff, save the two original screenshots through the local HTML form and close both helper tabs. Re-mark ECIL, LB Nagar, Kompally and Narsingi without resuming. Release owned lock and notify root at 21:56:23 UTC.

Accepted a fresh 920 m Airport Bawarchi approach. Last road-distance observation before flight was 779 m; final off-road estimate ~395 m is not comparable as a travelled-distance measure. No pickup, handover, reward or complete route outcome observed.

The final original shows blue train carriages high in frame and rail geometry near ground level. A continuous alignment/support or bridge-height test was not performed. This image alone does not establish a train-elevation defect.

limitations: Pickup and customer handover remain unfinished; no E prompt or completed interaction result.
Narrow-road steering errors and traffic interactions affected route progress; no unreachable pickup, hard route blocker or collision defect was established.
Road-route and approximate aerial/off-road distances are different modes. Their changes do not measure actual distance travelled.
Flight and a later grounded/off-road HUD were observed. No continuous touchdown recording was saved; the second Space tap did not immediately end the observed flight.
Ending car was paused at a displayed 16 km/h, not stopped at zero; all actual keys were released.
No controlled bridge/median/curb enforcement test; no Street View or real-world shop-order verification.
No picker cancel or theatre/post-delivery scenario was exercised.
Saved photo-like game screenshots are original browser output; they are not real-world street evidence.
Grounded/post-flight guidance was observed with 0.1 s boost still displayed; exact zero boost or complete exhaustion was not observed.

handoff.instruction: Continue the same uncollected Airport Bawarchi order. Paused off-road near rail geometry at ~395 m direct estimate and 16 km/h displayed speed, 0.1 s boost, 802 coins, Level 2 1/4. Expect movement on Resume and brake cautiously; do not assume the car is stopped. Click the visible scene after closing the map before using Space. Keep other accepted orders paused.
